question: Should published changelogs support audited replacement, append-only corrections, or remain immutable across both skills and packages?
rationale: Current main stores only one public changelog value and defines no correction provenance, so permanent history and authorization semantics require maintainer intent.

options.title: Audited revisions
options.body: Allow authorized replacement while retaining prior text, actor, timestamp, correction reason, and atomic projection updates.

options.title: Append-only corrections
options.body: Keep the original changelog immutable and attach a separately visible correction record.

options.title: Immutable changelogs
options.body: Require a new version to communicate corrected release notes and add no edit operation.

recommendation.title: Audited revisions
recommendation.body: Allow authorized replacement while retaining prior text, actor, timestamp, correction reason, and atomic projection updates.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the strongest direct blame and recent-history connection to release-version schemas and publishing lifecycle code.
